label: Scale Models
blurb: Things that arrive as sprues in a box and leave as an object on a shelf.

nodes.label: Gunpla
nodes.blurb: Bandai's snap-fit Gundam kits. No glue needed to start, no ceiling if you keep going.

levels.label: HG
levels.note: High Grade, 1/144. Snap together in an evening, no paint required.

levels.label: RG
levels.note: Real Grade, 1/144. Pre-coloured inner frame, decals, small parts.

levels.label: MG
levels.note: Master Grade, 1/100. Full inner frame, a weekend, real part count.

levels.label: PG
levels.note: Perfect Grade, 1/60. Lighting kits, hundreds of parts, a shelf of its own.

nodes.label: Scale Armour
nodes.blurb: Tanks at 1/35. Glue, putty and reference photos, where gunpla gives you none of the three.

levels.label: Out of box
levels.note: Build it as the instructions say and paint it one colour

levels.label: Scratch
levels.note: You make parts the kit does not contain

nodes.label: Aircraft Kits
nodes.blurb: Canopies, camouflage masks and the long argument about panel line scale.

nodes.label: Dioramas
nodes.blurb: A base, a scene and a reason the model is standing where it is.

nodes.label: Airbrush Rig
nodes.blurb: Compressor, moisture trap, spray booth. The purchase that changes what finishes are possible.

nodes.label: Decals
nodes.blurb: Waterslides, setting solution and the silvering that gives away a rushed job.

edges.note: The first kit where nothing snaps and everything is glued.
